scope: One saved-native-byte source-quality qualification; only after PASS, one saved-scene CPU render with native-getter qualification before rendering, followed by image reopening. No GLB import, new source sampling or automatic retry is authorised.

review_independence.separate_exact_host_review: GO with no actionable findings; worker semantics reviewed independently here.

focused_evidence.scope: Synthetic complete original/holdout populations and112 rows, independent percentile, RGB and separate scalar rejection, native-getter override, invalid queries/support/cohorts, byte decoding, exact source pins and unreachable import commands. Initial module-resolution failure remains private; final actual modules resolve correctly.

phase1_review.reference_policy: Existing authenticated source-spatial F32 six-channel references, exact original face IDs/barycentrics/kinds and positive support; no new locations, field calls, fitting or observed-error selection.
phase1_review.representation: Saved native BYTE_COLOR bytes decoded with F64 IEC sRGB, rounded to F32 linear RGB, then interpolated and re-encoded under the historical original metric semantics. This is not a native getter bit-equality claim.
phase1_review.independent_check: A separate evaluator constructs all cohorts, performs independent interpolation/transfer, manual linear p95, RGB statistics and each scalar test. Every query is covered in required disjoint frozen regions; all112 rows must pass. Primary and independent row identities/counts/decisions and numerical statistics must agree within1e-12.
phase1_review.exact_saved_transport: All original referenced F32 positions, ordered oriented triangles and12,520,752 actual cornerRGBA bytes are rechecked against the preserved original source/native oracle before quality evaluation.
phase1_review.failed_evidence: The old ideal-half-bin verifier NO-GO and supervisor BLOCKED records remain pinned and unchanged. No new rounding ceiling is substituted.
phase1_review.failure_evidence: All primary and independent aggregate metric rows are durably saved before any quality-gate rejection. Raw predictions remain private.

phase2_review.scene_policy: Open the existing unchanged saved scene with scripts disabled; no GLB import call exists in the worker. Recheck exact source geometry, imported material and all stored corner bytes.
phase2_review.actual_getter: Bulk-read the actual native BYTE_COLOR .color F32 RGBA values. Map them to original source IDs and require repeated corners to retain bit-identical RGB; all112 original material gates are then evaluated on this actual getter representation before the render call. Unreferenced fallback rows never appear in a triangle query.
phase2_review.getter_failure_evidence: Save all actual-native-getter aggregate metric rows before rejecting any failed gate.
phase2_review.render: Exactly one original +X orthographic640x64032-sample CyclesCPU view, OpenImageDenoiseCPU, four threads, no adaptive sampling, original camera/neutral studio, AgX/None/+2EV.
phase2_review.postconditions: Original exact geometry, material wiring/scalars and every stored corner byte must remain unchanged after rendering. No scene save, attribute replacement, geometry repair, export or extra view.
phase2_review.inspection: Fresh owned CPU PNG reopening and labelled private contextual comparison. Independent visual review is still required; source/shading differences prohibit a pixel-perfect reference-equivalence claim.

resource_review.ownership: Fresh exclusive stage outputs and markers, exact reviewed complete source set/plan/log/audit identities, qualifying worker and owned-host PASS with exact receipt binding, current RAM/disk admission, binary GO after Job attachment, periodic checks, unchanged watched sources/prior outputs and natural empty owned Job without forced cleanup.
resource_review.projection_limit: Prior import/render measurements support planning; the hard caps and live resource floors remain mandatory and are not raised.

stop_rule: If qualification, actual native getter gates, render, image reopening or owned supervision fails, preserve all evidence and stop. No GLB reimport, automatic retry, extra view, quality-threshold relaxation, fitting, source modification or native probe.
